experiences.name: Djemaa el-Fna Square & Medina Exploration
experiences.description: Immerse yourself in the beating heart of Marrakech at the UNESCO-listed Djemaa el-Fna square. Watch snake charmers, storytellers, and musicians perform as the square transforms from a daytime market into a spectacular evening food and entertainment spectacle. Wander the labyrinthine souks of the ancient medina nearby, haggling for spices, leather goods, and handcrafted lanterns.

experiences.name: Sahara Desert Camel Trek & Overnight Camp
experiences.description: Journey to the golden dunes of Erg Chebbi near Merzouga for a sunset camel trek into the Sahara. Spend the night in a traditional Berber desert camp under a canopy of stars, enjoy live Gnawa music around a campfire, sip mint tea, and wake at dawn to witness a breathtaking sunrise over the dunes. A truly once-in-a-lifetime desert experience.
experiences.location: Erg Chebbi Dunes, Merzouga, Sahara Desert

experiences.name: Bahia Palace & Saadian Tombs Historical Tour
experiences.description: Explore two of Marrakech's most stunning historical monuments within walking distance of the medina. The 19th-century Bahia Palace dazzles with intricate zellij tilework, carved cedarwood ceilings, and lush gardens. The nearby Saadian Tombs, rediscovered in 1917, house the ornate mausoleums of the Saadian dynasty dating back to the 16th century, offering a profound glimpse into Morocco's royal history.

experiences.name: Traditional Moroccan Cooking Class & Souk Market Tour
experiences.description: Begin with a guided tour of the spice souks and fresh produce markets with a local chef, learning to select authentic Moroccan ingredients like ras el hanout, preserved lemons, and argan oil. Then head to a traditional riad kitchen to hand-craft a full Moroccan feast including harira soup, chicken tagine with preserved lemon and olives, and honey-drenched bastilla. Eat what you cook and take home the recipes.

experiences.name: Hammam & Moroccan Spa Ritual
experiences.description: Experience an authentic traditional hammam at a local bathhouse near the medina, a centuries-old Moroccan cleansing ritual. Be scrubbed with a kessa mitt to remove dead skin, lathered in black beldi soap made from olive oil, and treated to an argan oil massage. This deeply cultural wellness practice has been central to Moroccan social life for generations and provides total relaxation after days of exploration.
